hypothesis: The task-typed L9 state is produced distributively at the contextual carrier bank, so an exact greedy combination of full upstream attention-head and MLP responses will recover the donor behavior out of sample better than any singleton.

frozen_design.candidate_pool: For each task, all 20 top-and-bottom components frozen by the weight atlas: 12 attention heads and 8 MLPs. No component is filtered using the carrier-position validation outcome.
frozen_design.fit: jointly capable, direction-stratified A1 fit split only: 16 has/had rows and 8 is/was rows
frozen_design.sealed_evaluation: jointly capable A1 heldout and all A2 rows: 15+31 has/had, 6+15 is/was
frozen_design.intervention: Exact joint replacement of selected attention head slices and whole MLP outputs at paired contextual carrier positions in one causal forward
frozen_design.objective: greedily minimize rowwise mean squared error to unit donor recovery

predictions.pred_a_authority_capability_exact_instru: Every panel is natively capable and has the registered carrier-bank width.
predictions.pred_b_both_greedy_paths_are_distributiv: Each task selects between 2 and 6 components, and every accepted step strictly reduces fit MSE.
predictions.pred_c_both_paths_generalize_to_a1: Each final path has heldout A1 mean recovery at least 0.70, direction fraction at least 0.80, and lower unit-target RMSE than the best singleton.
predictions.pred_d_both_paths_transfer_to_a2: Each final path has A2 mean recovery at least 0.65, direction fraction at least 0.80, and lower unit-target RMSE than the best singleton.
predictions.pred_e_shared_program_machinery: The independently selected task programs share at least two component labels.
predictions.pred_f_price_and_coverage: Execution remains within 322 forwards, 4377 example evaluations, and 4195 intervention records with no fitting or backward passes.

decision: screen only if all predictions pass; null on a scientific prediction failure; invalid on authority, capability, instrument, coverage, or price failure
heldout_policy: The greedy path is chosen only on A1 fit. Heldout A1 and A2 outcomes cannot change the selected program.
